-P INPUT ACCEPT
-P FORWARD ACCEPT
-P OUTPUT ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p udp -m udp --dport 51820 -m comment --comment "kaskad:51820:udp" -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 8443 -m comment --comment "kaskad:8443:tcp" -j ACCEPT
-A INPUT -p tcp -m tcp --dport 443 -m comment --comment "kaskad:443:tcp" -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -s 198.51.100.30/32 -p udp -m udp --sport 51820 -m state --state RELATED,ESTABLISHED -m comment --comment "kaskad:51820:udp" -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -d 198.51.100.30/32 -p udp -m udp --dport 51820 -m state --state NEW,RELATED,ESTABLISHED -m comment --comment "kaskad:51820:udp" -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -s 198.51.100.20/32 -p tcp -m tcp --sport 443 -m state --state RELATED,ESTABLISHED -m comment --comment "kaskad:8443:tcp" -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -d 198.51.100.20/32 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 443 -m state --state NEW,RELATED,ESTABLISHED -m comment --comment "kaskad:8443:tcp" -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -s 198.51.100.20/32 -p tcp -m tcp --sport 443 -m state --state RELATED,ESTABLISHED -m comment --comment "kaskad:443:tcp" -j ACCEPT
-A FORWARD -d 198.51.100.20/32 -p tcp -m tcp --dport 443 -m state --state NEW,RELATED,ESTABLISHED -m comment --comment "kaskad:443:tcp" -j ACCEPT
